title: A Status Update, a Music Room, and More

blocks.source: 近況報告とか音楽室とか
blocks.translation: A Status Update, a Music Room, and More

blocks.source: お久しぶりです。
blocks.translation: It's been a while.

blocks.source: ブログを放置しているうちに元号が変わってしまいましたが、皆様はいかがお過ごしでしょうか？
blocks.translation: While I was neglecting the blog, the imperial era changed. How have you all been?

blocks.source: 僕は至って元気です。
blocks.translation: I'm doing perfectly well.

blocks.source: 相変わらず、週休三日でまったりプログラマーをしながら、趣味に時間を使う毎日です。
blocks.translation: As usual, I spend my days working as a laid-back programmer with a three-day weekend, while making time for my hobbies.

blocks.source: ちなみに、ここ一年半ほどは某政令指定都市向けのシステム開発をやっていました。
blocks.translation: By the way, for about the past year and a half, I've been developing a system for a certain designated city.

blocks.source: でもって、最近は元号対応に携わっていました。
blocks.translation: More recently, I've been working on adapting it to the new imperial era.

blocks.source: 今時、民間企業向けのシステムは西暦派が大多数なので、元号対応はほとんどないと思います。そう考えると、案外貴重な経験ができたと言えるかもしれません。
blocks.translation: These days, most systems for private companies use the Western calendar, so I doubt there are many opportunities to adapt them to the imperial era. In that sense, I may have had a surprisingly valuable experience.

blocks.source: ……まあ、あまり面白くない仕事でしたけど。
blocks.translation: ...Well, it wasn't a particularly interesting job.

blocks.source: なんせ、共通処理を修正してしまえば、後は動作確認だけです。その動作確認が問題で、大量の画面の日付項目を黙々とチェックするというスキルも何も関係ない苦行を延々と……。
blocks.translation: Once the common processing was modified, all that remained was testing. And that testing was the problem: endlessly and mindlessly checking the date fields on a huge number of screens—a grueling task in which skill had nothing to do with it...

blocks.source: ともかく、その甲斐あって、各種画面やら申請書類には無事『令和』と表示されるようになりました。市民の皆様もご安心ください。
blocks.translation: Anyway, thanks to that effort, "Reiwa" is now displayed properly on various screens and application forms. Citizens, you can rest assured.

blocks.source: ※「どこ市だよ」ってツッコミは置いておくとして。
blocks.translation: ※Leaving aside the question, "Which city are you talking about?"

blocks.source: 以上、お仕事の話は終わりです。
blocks.translation: That's all for the work talk.

blocks.source: 例によって、ブログを放置しているのはネタがないだけなので、あまり気にしないでください。
blocks.translation: As usual, the only reason I've been neglecting the blog is that I have nothing to write about, so please don't worry about it too much.

blocks.source: 更新を半年ほどしないでおくと、邪魔な広告が表示されたりするので、そこだけは最低限の保守をしておこうかなと。
blocks.translation: If I go about six months without updating it, annoying advertisements start appearing, so I think I'll at least do the minimum maintenance necessary to prevent that.

blocks.source: せっかく書き溜めたので、講座とかの内容は長く活用して欲しいと思っています。『久し振りに見に来たら、邪魔な広告が！』っていうのは萎えますしね。
blocks.translation: Since I took the trouble to write all that material, I hope the guides and other content will continue to be useful for a long time. It would be discouraging to come back after a long absence and find annoying advertisements!

blocks.source: ※スマホ版で広告を消せないのはSeesaaブログの仕様のようです。最近、確認したら酷くて笑うしかありませんでした。ていうか、有料プランでも消えないとか……。
blocks.translation: ※It seems that being unable to remove advertisements from the smartphone version is simply a Seesaa Blog specification. When I checked recently, it was so bad that I could only laugh. I mean, they don't even disappear with a paid plan...

blocks.source: なお、創作活動自体は水面下でやっています。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, I am still pursuing creative activities behind the scenes.

blocks.source: 基本、黙々と創るほうが好きな性質なもので、ロクに報告もせずにすみません。
blocks.translation: I generally prefer to create quietly and diligently, so I'm sorry I haven't given you much of a report.

blocks.source: そろそろ執筆修行の成果を見せられないかなと思ったり……。ダメそうなら封印しますが。
blocks.translation: I'm wondering if I might be able to show you the results of my writing practice soon... Though if they don't seem good enough, I'll lock them away.

blocks.source: でもって、ＲＰＧ制作そのものは休止中です。構想がないこともないので、今やってる作業が終わったらどうしようかなってところですが……。
blocks.translation: As for RPG development itself, it's currently on hold. It's not that I have no ideas, so I'm still wondering what to do once I finish the work I'm currently doing...

blocks.source: ミスタ＆ラビスタで使用されている音楽を、鑑賞用にちょっとずつ置いていきます。
blocks.translation: I'll gradually be posting music used in Mista & Labista for your listening pleasure.

blocks.source: まあ、別にゲーム本体のMusicフォルダから抽出してもいいのですが。音質が若干良かったり、演奏時間が長めだったりします。
blocks.translation: Of course, you could just extract it from the game's Music folder. However, the sound quality is slightly better, and the tracks are a bit longer.

blocks.source: あと、作者のコメントとかお気に入り度も付いてます。
blocks.translation: I'll also include comments from the creator and a favorite rating.

blocks.source: ついでに、没曲とかも置いてみてもいいかもしれませんね。
blocks.translation: I might as well post some unused tracks, too.

blocks.source: あとあと、言い訳ですが。
blocks.translation: And one more thing—a word of explanation.

blocks.source: ＰＣを買い替えて以降、ハードウェア音源からの録音環境が整っていません。
blocks.translation: Since replacing my PC, I haven't had a proper setup for recording from hardware sound sources.

blocks.source: なので、どこかから引っ張り出してきて、編集しただけの曲が多めです。
blocks.translation: Consequently, many of the tracks have simply been pulled from somewhere and edited.

blocks.source: 演奏時間が半端だったり、作中と音色が違ってたりしたら、そのせいだと思ってください。
blocks.translation: If a track has an awkward duration or sounds different from how it does in the game, please assume that's why.

lines.source: それと、何も更新しないのも何なので[[LINK_1]]音楽室（リンク）[[/LINK_1]]を作ってみました。

parts.source: それと、何も更新しないのも何なので

lines.translation: Also, since it would be a bit odd not to update anything, I tried creating the [[LINK_1]]Music Room (link)[[/LINK_1]].
